sql:
WITH MostCommonCombinations AS (
    SELECT 
        m.molecule_id,
        a1.element AS element1,
        a2.element AS element2,
        COUNT(*) AS combination_count,
        ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY m.molecule_id ORDER BY COUNT(*) DESC) AS rn
    FROM 
        connected c
    JOIN 
        atom a1 ON c.atom_id = a1.atom_id
    JOIN 
        atom a2 ON c.atom_id2 = a2.atom_id
    JOIN 
        molecule m ON a1.molecule_id = m.molecule_id
    WHERE 
        a1.element < a2.element
    GROUP BY 
        m.molecule_id, a1.element, a2.element
)
SELECT 
    molecule_id,
    element1,
    element2,
    combination_count
FROM 
    MostCommonCombinations
WHERE 
    rn = 1;

        m.molecule_id,
        a1.element AS element1,
        a2.element AS element2,

        ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY m.molecule_id ORDER BY COUNT(*) DESC) AS rn
    FROM 
        connected c

        atom a1 ON c.atom_id = a1.atom_id

        a1.element < a2.element
    GROUP BY 
        m.molecule_id, a1.element, a2.element

    molecule_id,
    element1,
    element2,
    combination_count
FROM 
    ElementCombinations

SELECT 
    element1, 
    element2, 
    SUM(combination_count) AS total_combination_count
FROM (
    SELECT 
        m.molecule_id,
        a1.element AS element1,
        a2.element AS element2,
        COUNT(*) AS combination_count
    FROM 
        connected c
    JOIN 
        atom a1 ON c.atom_id = a1.atom_id
    JOIN 
        atom a2 ON c.atom_id2 = a2.atom_id
    JOIN 
        molecule m ON a1.molecule_id = m.molecule_id
    WHERE 
        a1.element < a2.element
    GROUP BY 
        m.molecule_id, a1.element, a2.element
) subquery
GROUP BY 
    element1, element2
ORDER BY 
    total_combination_count DESC
LIMIT 1;

WITH ElementCombinations AS (
    SELECT 
        m.molecule_id,
        a1.element AS element1,
        a2.element AS element2,
        COUNT(*) AS combination_count,
        ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY m.molecule_id ORDER BY COUNT(*) DESC) AS rn
    FROM 
        connected c
    JOIN 
        atom a1 ON c.atom_id = a1.atom_id
    JOIN 
        atom a2 ON c.atom_id2 = a2.atom_id
    JOIN 
        molecule m ON a1.molecule_id = m.molecule_id
    WHERE 
        a1.element < a2.element
    GROUP BY 
        m.molecule_id, a1.element, a2.element
)
SELECT 
    molecule_id,
    element1,
    element2,
    combination_count
FROM 
    ElementCombinations
WHERE 
    rn = 1;

WITH ElementCombinations AS (
    SELECT 
        m.molecule_id,
        a1.element AS element1,
        a2.element AS element2,
        COUNT(*) AS combination_count,
        ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY m.molecule_id ORDER BY COUNT(*) DESC) AS rn

        molecule m ON a1.molecule_id = m.molecule_id
    WHERE 
        a1.element < a2.element
    GROUP BY 
        m.molecule_id, a1.element, a2.element

    molecule_id,
    element1,
    element2,
    combination_count
FROM 
    ElementCombinations
WHERE 
    rn = 1;

    SELECT 
        m.molecule_id,
        a1.element AS element1,
        a2.element AS element2,
        COUNT(*) AS combination_count,
        ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY m.molecule_id ORDER BY COUNT(*) DESC) AS rn

        connected c

        atom a1 ON c.atom_id = a1.atom_id

        atom a2 ON c.atom_id2 = a2.atom_id
    JOIN 
        molecule m ON a1.molecule_id = m.molecule_id
    WHERE 
        a1.element < a2.element
    GROUP BY 
        m.molecule_id, a1.element, a2.element
)
SELECT 
    molecule_id,
    element1,
    element2,
    combination_count
FROM 
    ElementCombinations
WHERE 
    rn = 1;

WITH ElementCombinations AS (
    SELECT 
        m.molecule_id,
        a1.element AS element1,
        a2.element AS element2,
        COUNT(*) AS combination_count,
        ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY m.molecule_id ORDER BY COUNT(*) DESC) AS rn
    FROM 
        connected c
    JOIN 
        atom a1 ON c.atom_id = a1.atom_id
    JOIN 
        atom a2 ON c.atom_id2 = a2.atom_id
    JOIN 
        molecule m ON a1.molecule_id = m.molecule_id
    WHERE 
        a1.element < a2.element
    GROUP BY 
        m.molecule_id, a1.element, a2.element
)
SELECT 
    molecule_id,
    element1,
    element2,
    combination_count
FROM 
    ElementCombinations
WHERE 
    rn = 1;

SELECT 
    t.GasStationID,
    t.ProductID,
    t.Price,
    a.Country,
    a.Segment,
    a.AvgPrice
FROM 
    transactions_1k t
JOIN 
    gasstations g ON t.GasStationID = g.GasStationID

    (
        SELECT 
            g.Country,
            g.Segment,
            t.ProductID,
            AVG(t.Price) AS AvgPrice
        FROM 
            transactions_1k t
        JOIN 
            gasstations g ON t.GasStationID = g.GasStationID
        GROUP BY 
            g.Country, g.Segment, t.ProductID
    ) a ON g.Country = a.Country AND g.Segment = a.Segment AND t.ProductID = a.ProductID
WHERE 
    t.Price < a.AvgPrice;

WITH ElementCombinations AS (
    SELECT 
        m.molecule_id,
        a1.element AS element1,
        a2.element AS element2,
        COUNT(*) AS combination_count,
        ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY m.molecule_id ORDER BY COUNT(*) DESC) AS rn
    FROM 
        connected c
    JOIN 
        atom a1 ON c.atom_id = a1.atom_id
    JOIN 
        atom a2 ON c.atom_id2 = a2.atom_id
    JOIN 
        molecule m ON a1.molecule_id = m.molecule_id
    WHERE 
        a1.element < a2.element
    GROUP BY 
        m.molecule_id, a1.element, a2.element
)
SELECT 
    molecule_id,
    element1,
    element2,
    combination_count
FROM 
    ElementCombinations
WHERE 
    rn = 1;

WITH MostCommonCombinations AS (
    SELECT 
        m.molecule_id,
        a1.element AS element1,
        a2.element AS element2,
        COUNT(*) AS combination_count,
        ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY m.molecule_id ORDER BY COUNT(*) DESC) AS rn
    FROM 
        connected c
    JOIN 
        atom a1 ON c.atom_id = a1.atom_id
    JOIN 
        atom a2 ON c.atom_id2 = a2.atom_id
    JOIN 
        molecule m ON a1.molecule_id = m.molecule_id
    WHERE 
        a1.element < a2.element
    GROUP BY 
        m.molecule_id, a1.element, a2.element
)
SELECT 
    molecule_id,
    element1,
    element2,
    combination_count
FROM 
    MostCommonCombinations
WHERE 
    rn = 1;

WITH ElementCombinations AS (
    SELECT 
        m.molecule_id,
        a1.element AS element1,
        a2.element AS element2,
        COUNT(*) AS combination_count,
        ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY m.molecule_id ORDER BY COUNT(*) DESC) AS rn
    FROM 
        connected c
    JOIN 
        atom a1 ON c.atom_id = a1.atom_id
    JOIN 
        atom a2 ON c.atom_id2 = a2.atom_id
    JOIN 
        molecule m ON a1.molecule_id = m.molecule_id
    WHERE 
        a1.element < a2.element
    GROUP BY 
        m.molecule_id, a1.element, a2.element
)
SELECT 
    molecule_id,
    element1,
    element2,
    combination_count
FROM 
    ElementCombinations
WHERE 
    rn = 1;

SELECT 
    g.Country,
    COUNT(DISTINCT t.GasStationID) AS ValueForMoneyGasStations
FROM 
    transactions_1k t
JOIN 
    gasstations g ON t.GasStationID = g.GasStationID
JOIN 
    (
        SELECT 
            g.Country,
            g.Segment,
            t.ProductID,
            AVG(t.Price) AS AvgPrice
        FROM 
            transactions_1k t
        JOIN 
            gasstations g ON t.GasStationID = g.GasStationID
        GROUP BY 
            g.Country, g.Segment, t.ProductID
    ) ap ON g.Country = ap.Country AND t.ProductID = ap.ProductID
WHERE 
    t.Price < ap.AvgPrice
GROUP BY 
    g.Country;

WITH MostCommonCombinations AS (
    SELECT 
        m.molecule_id,
        a1.element AS element1,
        a2.element AS element2
    FROM 
        connected c
    JOIN 
        atom a1 ON c.atom_id = a1.atom_id
    JOIN 
        atom a2 ON c.atom_id2 = a2.atom_id
    JOIN 
        molecule m ON a1.molecule_id = m.molecule_id
    WHERE 
        a1.element < a2.element
    GROUP BY 
        m.molecule_id, a1.element, a2.element
    QUALIFY 
        ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY m.molecule_id ORDER BY COUNT(*) DESC) = 1
)
SELECT 
    COUNT(b.bond_id) AS most_common_bond_count
FROM 
    bond b
JOIN 
    connected c ON b.bond_id = c.bond_id
JOIN 
    atom a1 ON c.atom_id = a1.atom_id
JOIN 
    atom a2 ON c.atom_id2 = a2.atom_id
JOIN 
    MostCommonCombinations mcc ON a1.molecule_id = mcc.molecule_id
    AND ((a1.element = mcc.element1 AND a2.element = mcc.element2) OR (a1.element = mcc.element2 AND a2.element = mcc.element1));

WITH MostCommonCombinations AS (
    SELECT 
        m.molecule_id,
        a1.element AS element1,
        a2.element AS element2
    FROM 
        connected c
    JOIN 
        atom a1 ON c.atom_id = a1.atom_id
    JOIN 
        atom a2 ON c.atom_id2 = a2.atom_id
    JOIN 
        molecule m ON a1.molecule_id = m.molecule_id
    WHERE 
        a1.element < a2.element
    GROUP BY 
        m.molecule_id, a1.element, a2.element
    QUALIFY 
        ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY m.molecule_id ORDER BY COUNT(*) DESC) = 1
)
SELECT 
    COUNT(b.bond_id) AS common_combination_bond_count
FROM 
    bond b
JOIN 
    connected c ON b.bond_id = c.bond_id
JOIN 
    atom a1 ON c.atom_id = a1.atom_id
JOIN 
    atom a2 ON c.atom_id2 = a2.atom_id
JOIN 
    MostCommonCombinations mcc ON a1.molecule_id = mcc.molecule_id 
        AND a1.element = mcc.element1 
        AND a2.element = mcc.element2;

WITH MostCommonCombinations AS (
    SELECT 
        m.molecule_id,
        a1.element AS element1,
        a2.element AS element2
    FROM 
        connected c
    JOIN 
        atom a1 ON c.atom_id = a1.atom_id
    JOIN 
        atom a2 ON c.atom_id2 = a2.atom_id
    JOIN 
        molecule m ON a1.molecule_id = m.molecule_id
    WHERE 
        a1.element < a2.element
    GROUP BY 
        m.molecule_id, a1.element, a2.element
    QUALIFY 
        ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY m.molecule_id ORDER BY COUNT(*) DESC) = 1
)
SELECT 
    COUNT(DISTINCT b.bond_id) AS common_combination_bond_count
FROM 
    bond b
JOIN 
    connected c ON b.bond_id = c.bond_id
JOIN 
    atom a1 ON c.atom_id = a1.atom_id
JOIN 
    atom a2 ON c.atom_id2 = a2.atom_id
JOIN 
    MostCommonCombinations mcc ON a1.molecule_id = mcc.molecule_id 
        AND a1.element = mcc.element1 
        AND a2.element = mcc.element2;

sql:
WITH MostCommonCombinations AS (
    SELECT 
        m.molecule_id,
        a1.element AS element1,
        a2.element AS element2,
        COUNT(*) AS combination_count,
        ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY m.molecule_id ORDER BY COUNT(*) DESC) AS rn
    FROM 
        connected c
    JOIN 
        atom a1 ON c.atom_id = a1.atom_id
    JOIN 
        atom a2 ON c.atom_id2 = a2.atom_id
    JOIN 
        molecule m ON a1.molecule_id = m.molecule_id
    WHERE 
        a1.element < a2.element
    GROUP BY 
        m.molecule_id, a1.element, a2.element
),
TopCombinations AS (
    SELECT 
        molecule_id,
        element1,
        element2
    FROM 
        MostCommonCombinations
    WHERE 
        rn = 1
)
SELECT 
    COUNT(DISTINCT b.bond_id) AS common_combination_bond_count
FROM 
    connected c
JOIN 
    atom a1 ON c.atom_id = a1.atom_id
JOIN 
    atom a2 ON c.atom_id2 = a2.atom_id
JOIN 
    bond b ON c.bond_id = b.bond_id
JOIN 
    TopCombinations tc ON a1.molecule_id = tc.molecule_id 
                        AND a1.element = tc.element1 
                        AND a2.element = tc.element2;

SELECT 
    latest.ID,
    latest.UA,
    latest.SEX
FROM 
    (SELECT 
        l.ID,
        l.UA,
        p.SEX,
        ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY l.ID ORDER BY l.Date DESC) as rn
     FROM 
        Laboratory l
     JOIN 
        Patient p ON l.ID = p.ID) latest
WHERE

WITH MostCommonCombinations AS (
    SELECT 
        m.molecule_id,
        a1.element AS element1,
        a2.element AS element2
    FROM 
        connected c
    JOIN 
        atom a1 ON c.atom_id = a1.atom_id
    JOIN 
        atom a2 ON c.atom_id2 = a2.atom_id
    JOIN 
        molecule m ON a1.molecule_id = m.molecule_id
    WHERE 
        a1.element < a2.element
    GROUP BY 
        m.molecule_id, a1.element, a2.element
    QUALIFY 
        ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY m.molecule_id ORDER BY COUNT(*) DESC) = 1
)

    COUNT(b.bond_id) AS common_combination_bond_count
FROM 
    bond b
JOIN 
    connected c ON b.bond_id = c.bond_id
JOIN 
    atom a1 ON c.atom_id = a1.atom_id
JOIN 
    atom a2 ON c.atom_id2 = a2.atom_id
JOIN 
    MostCommonCombinations mcc ON a1.molecule_id = mcc.molecule_id 
        AND a1.element = mcc.element1 
        AND a2.element = mcc.element2;

WITH MostCommonCombinations AS (
    SELECT 
        m.molecule_id,
        a1.element AS element1,
        a2.element AS element2
    FROM 
        connected c
    JOIN 
        atom a1 ON c.atom_id = a1.atom_id
    JOIN 
        atom a2 ON c.atom_id2 = a2.atom_id
    JOIN 
        molecule m ON a1.molecule_id = m.molecule_id
    WHERE 
        a1.element < a2.element
    GROUP BY 
        m.molecule_id, a1.element, a2.element
    QUALIFY 
        ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY m.molecule_id ORDER BY COUNT(*) DESC) = 1
)
SELECT 
    COUNT(DISTINCT b.bond_id) AS common_combination_bond_count
FROM 
    bond b
JOIN 
    connected c ON b.bond_id = c.bond_id
JOIN 
    atom a1 ON c.atom_id = a1.atom_id
JOIN 
    atom a2 ON c.atom_id2 = a2.atom_id
JOIN 
    MostCommonCombinations mcc ON a1.molecule_id = mcc.molecule_id 
        AND a1.element = mcc.element1 
        AND a2.element = mcc.element2;

sql:
WITH MostCommonCombinations AS (
    SELECT 
        m.molecule_id,
        a1.element AS element1,
        a2.element AS element2,
        COUNT(*) AS combination_count,
        ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY m.molecule_id ORDER BY COUNT(*) DESC) AS rn
    FROM 
        connected c
    JOIN 
        atom a1 ON c.atom_id = a1.atom_id
    JOIN 
        atom a2 ON c.atom_id2 = a2.atom_id
    JOIN 
        molecule m ON a1.molecule_id = m.molecule_id
    WHERE 
        a1.element < a2.element
    GROUP BY 
        m.molecule_id, a1.element, a2.element
),
TopCombinations AS (
    SELECT 
        molecule_id,
        element1,
        element2
    FROM 
        MostCommonCombinations
    WHERE 
        rn = 1
)
SELECT 
    COUNT(DISTINCT b.bond_id) AS common_combination_bond_count
FROM 
    connected c
JOIN 
    atom a1 ON c.atom_id = a1.atom_id
JOIN 
    atom a2 ON c.atom_id2 = a2.atom_id
JOIN 
    bond b ON c.bond_id = b.bond_id
JOIN 
    TopCombinations tc ON a1.molecule_id = tc.molecule_id 
                        AND a1.element = tc.element1 
                        AND a2.element = tc.element2;

    SELECT 
        m.molecule_id,
        a1.element AS element1,
        a2.element AS element2
    FROM 
        connected c
    JOIN

        molecule m ON a1.molecule_id = m.molecule_id

    QUALIFY 
        ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY m.molecule_id ORDER BY COUNT(*) DESC) = 1

WITH loan_counts AS (
    SELECT 
        dist.A2 AS region,
        CASE 
            WHEN l.amount < 50000 THEN 'Small'
            ELSE 'Medium'
        END AS loan_size_category,
        l.status,
        COUNT(*) AS loan_count
    FROM 
        loan l
    JOIN 
        account a ON l.account_id = a.account_id
    JOIN 
        district dist ON a.district_id = dist.district_id
    WHERE 
        l.amount < 100000
    GROUP BY 
        dist.A2, loan_size_category, l.status
),
status_c_counts AS (
    SELECT 
        region,
        loan_size_category,
        loan_count AS c_count
    FROM 
        loan_counts
    WHERE 
        status = 'C'
),
total_counts AS (
    SELECT 
        region,
        loan_size_category,
        SUM(loan_count) AS total_count
    FROM 
        loan_counts
    GROUP BY 
        region, loan_size_category
)
SELECT 
    tc.region,
    tc.loan_size_category,
    COALESCE(sc.c_count, 0) AS c_count,
    tc.total_count,
    (COALESCE(sc.c_count, 0) * 100.0 / tc.total_count) AS percentage_c
FROM 
    total_counts tc
LEFT JOIN 
    status_c_counts sc ON tc.region = sc.region AND tc.loan_size_category = sc.loan_size_category
ORDER BY 
    tc.region, tc.loan_size_category;

WITH loan_counts AS (
    SELECT 
        dist.A2 AS region,
        CASE 
            WHEN l.amount < 50000 THEN 'Small'
            ELSE 'Medium'
        END AS loan_size_category,
        l.status,
        COUNT(*) AS loan_count
    FROM 
        loan l
    JOIN 
        account a ON l.account_id = a.account_id
    JOIN 
        district dist ON a.district_id = dist.district_id
    WHERE 
        l.amount < 100000
    GROUP BY 
        dist.A2, loan_size_category, l.status
),
status_c_counts AS (
    SELECT 
        region,
        loan_size_category,
        loan_count AS c_count
    FROM 
        loan_counts
    WHERE 
        status = 'C'
),
total_counts AS (
    SELECT 
        region,
        loan_size_category,
        SUM(loan_count) AS total_count
    FROM 
        loan_counts
    GROUP BY 
        region, loan_size_category
)
SELECT 
    tc.region,
    tc.loan_size_category,
    COALESCE(sc.c_count, 0) AS c_count,
    tc.total_count,
    (COALESCE(sc.c_count, 0) * 100.0 / tc.total_count) AS c_percentage
FROM 
    total_counts tc
LEFT JOIN 
    status_c_counts sc ON tc.region = sc.region AND tc.loan_size_category = sc.loan_size_category;

WITH AvgPrices AS (
    SELECT 
        g.Country,
        g.Segment,
        t.ProductID,
        AVG(t.Price) AS AvgPrice
    FROM 
        transactions_1k t
    JOIN 
        gasstations g ON t.GasStationID = g.GasStationID
    GROUP BY 
        g.Country, g.Segment, t.ProductID
),
ValueForMoneyTransactions AS (
    SELECT 
        t.GasStationID,
        g.Country,
        t.ProductID,
        t.Price,
        ap.AvgPrice
    FROM 
        transactions_1k t
    JOIN 
        gasstations g ON t.GasStationID = g.GasStationID
    JOIN 
        AvgPrices ap ON g.Country = ap.Country AND g.Segment = ap.Segment AND t.ProductID = ap.ProductID
    WHERE 
        t.Price < ap.AvgPrice
)

SELECT 
    Country,
    COUNT(DISTINCT GasStationID) AS ValueForMoneyGasStations
FROM 
    ValueForMoneyTransactions

            WHEN l.amount < 50000 THEN 'Small'
            ELSE 'Medium'
        END AS loan_size_category,
        l.status,
        COUNT(*) AS loan_count
    FROM

total_counts AS (
    SELECT 
        region,
        loan_size_category,
        SUM(loan_count) AS total_count

        loan_counts

),

        tc.region,

        COALESCE(sc.c_count, 0) AS c_count,
        tc.total_count,

        total_counts tc

        status_c_counts sc ON tc.region = sc.region AND tc.loan_size_category = sc.loan_size_category
)

sql:
WITH MostCommonCombinations AS (
    SELECT 
        m.molecule_id,
        a1.element AS element1,
        a2.element AS element2,
        COUNT(*) AS combination_count,
        ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY m.molecule_id ORDER BY COUNT(*) DESC) AS rn
    FROM 
        connected c
    JOIN 
        atom a1 ON c.atom_id = a1.atom_id
    JOIN 
        atom a2 ON c.atom_id2 = a2.atom_id
    JOIN 
        molecule m ON a1.molecule_id = m.molecule_id
    WHERE 
        a1.element < a2.element
    GROUP BY 
        m.molecule_id, a1.element, a2.element
),
TopCombinations AS (
    SELECT 
        molecule_id,
        element1,
        element2
    FROM 
        MostCommonCombinations
    WHERE 
        rn = 1
),
CommonCombinationBondCount AS (
    SELECT 
        COUNT(DISTINCT b.bond_id) AS common_combination_bond_count
    FROM 
        connected c
    JOIN 
        atom a1 ON c.atom_id = a1.atom_id
    JOIN 
        atom a2 ON c.atom_id2 = a2.atom_id
    JOIN 
        bond b ON c.bond_id = b.bond_id
    JOIN 
        TopCombinations tc ON a1.molecule_id = tc.molecule_id 
                            AND a1.element = tc.element1 
                            AND a2.element = tc.element2
),
TotalBondCount AS (
    SELECT 
        COUNT(DISTINCT bond_id) AS total_bond_count
    FROM 
        bond
)
SELECT 
    (common_combination_bond_count * 100.0 / total_bond_count) AS percentage
FROM 
    CommonCombinationBondCount, TotalBondCount;

WITH loan_counts AS (
    SELECT 
        dist.A2 AS region,
        CASE 
            WHEN l.amount < 50000 THEN 'Small'
            ELSE 'Medium'
        END AS loan_size_category,
        l.status,
        COUNT(*) AS loan_count
    FROM 
        loan l
    JOIN 
        account a ON l.account_id = a.account_id
    JOIN 
        district dist ON a.district_id = dist.district_id
    WHERE 
        l.amount < 100000
    GROUP BY 
        dist.A2, loan_size_category, l.status
),
status_c_counts AS (
    SELECT 
        region,
        loan_size_category,
        loan_count AS c_count
    FROM 
        loan_counts
    WHERE 
        status = 'C'
),
total_counts AS (
    SELECT 
        region,
        loan_size_category,
        SUM(loan_count) AS total_count
    FROM 
        loan_counts
    GROUP BY 
        region, loan_size_category
),
percentage_c AS (
    SELECT 
        tc.region,
        tc.loan_size_category,
        COALESCE(sc.c_count, 0) AS c_count,
        tc.total_count,
        (COALESCE(sc.c_count, 0) * 100.0 / tc.total_count) AS percentage_c
    FROM 
        total_counts tc
    LEFT JOIN 
        status_c_counts sc ON tc.region = sc.region AND tc.loan_size_category = sc.loan_size_category
)
SELECT 
    AVG(percentage_c) AS overall_average_percentage_c
FROM 
    percentage_c;

sql:
WITH MostCommonCombinations AS (
    SELECT 
        m.molecule_id,
        a1.element AS element1,
        a2.element AS element2,
        COUNT(*) AS combination_count,
        ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY m.molecule_id ORDER BY COUNT(*) DESC) AS rn
    FROM 
        connected c
    JOIN 
        atom a1 ON c.atom_id = a1.atom_id
    JOIN 
        atom a2 ON c.atom_id2 = a2.atom_id
    JOIN 
        molecule m ON a1.molecule_id = m.molecule_id
    WHERE 
        a1.element < a2.element
    GROUP BY 
        m.molecule_id, a1.element, a2.element
),
TopCombinations AS (
    SELECT 
        molecule_id,
        element1,
        element2
    FROM 
        MostCommonCombinations
    WHERE 
        rn = 1
),
CommonCombinationBondCount AS (
    SELECT 
        COUNT(DISTINCT b.bond_id) AS common_combination_bond_count
    FROM 
        connected c
    JOIN 
        atom a1 ON c.atom_id = a1.atom_id
    JOIN 
        atom a2 ON c.atom_id2 = a2.atom_id
    JOIN 
        bond b ON c.bond_id = b.bond_id
    JOIN 
        TopCombinations tc ON a1.molecule_id = tc.molecule_id 
                            AND a1.element = tc.element1 
                            AND a2.element = tc.element2
),
TotalBondCount AS (
    SELECT 
        COUNT(DISTINCT bond_id) AS total_bond_count
    FROM 
        bond
)
SELECT 
    (common_combination_bond_count * 100.0 / total_bond_count) AS percentage
FROM 
    CommonCombinationBondCount, TotalBondCount;

WITH loan_counts AS (

        dist.A2 AS region,
        CASE 
            WHEN l.amount < 50000 THEN 'Small'
            ELSE 'Medium'
        END AS loan_size_category,
        l.status,
        COUNT(*) AS loan_count

        region,
        loan_size_category,
        SUM(loan_count) AS total_count

        loan_counts

        region, loan_size_category

        tc.region,

        COALESCE(sc.c_count, 0) AS c_count,
        tc.total_count,

        total_counts tc

WITH MostCommonCombinations AS (
    SELECT 
        m.molecule_id,
        a1.element AS element1,
        a2.element AS element2
    FROM 
        connected c
    JOIN 
        atom a1 ON c.atom_id = a1.atom_id
    JOIN 
        atom a2 ON c.atom_id2 = a2.atom_id
    JOIN 
        molecule m ON a1.molecule_id = m.molecule_id
    WHERE 
        a1.element < a2.element
    GROUP BY 
        m.molecule_id, a1.element, a2.element
    QUALIFY 
        ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY m.molecule_id ORDER BY COUNT(*) DESC) = 1
),
MostCommonBondCount AS (
    SELECT 
        COUNT(b.bond_id) AS most_common_bond_count
    FROM 
        bond b
    JOIN 
        connected c ON b.bond_id = c.bond_id
    JOIN 
        atom a1 ON c.atom_id = a1.atom_id
    JOIN 
        atom a2 ON c.atom_id2 = a2.atom_id
    JOIN 
        MostCommonCombinations mcc ON a1.molecule_id = mcc.molecule_id 
            AND a1.element = mcc.element1 
            AND a2.element = mcc.element2
),
TotalBondCount AS (
    SELECT 
        COUNT(bond_id) AS total_bond_count
    FROM 
        bond
)
SELECT 
    (most_common_bond_count * 100.0 / total_bond_count) AS percentage_of_most_common_bonds
FROM 
    MostCommonBondCount, TotalBondCount;

WITH loan_counts AS (
    SELECT 
        dist.A2 AS region,
        CASE 
            WHEN l.amount < 50000 THEN 'Small'
            ELSE 'Medium'
        END AS loan_size_category,
        l.status,
        COUNT(*) AS loan_count
    FROM 
        loan l
    JOIN 
        account a ON l.account_id = a.account_id
    JOIN 
        district dist ON a.district_id = dist.district_id
    WHERE 
        l.amount < 100000
    GROUP BY 
        dist.A2, loan_size_category, l.status
),
status_c_counts AS (
    SELECT 
        region,
        loan_size_category,
        loan_count AS c_count
    FROM 
        loan_counts
    WHERE 
        status = 'C'
),
total_counts AS (
    SELECT 
        region,
        loan_size_category,
        SUM(loan_count) AS total_count
    FROM 
        loan_counts
    GROUP BY 
        region, loan_size_category
),
percentage_c AS (
    SELECT 
        tc.region,
        tc.loan_size_category,
        COALESCE(sc.c_count, 0) AS c_count,
        tc.total_count,
        (COALESCE(sc.c_count, 0) * 100.0 / tc.total_count) AS percentage_c
    FROM 
        total_counts tc
    LEFT JOIN 
        status_c_counts sc ON tc.region = sc.region AND tc.loan_size_category = sc.loan_size_category
)
SELECT 
    AVG(percentage_c) AS overall_average_percentage_c
FROM 
    percentage_c;

WITH MostCommonCombinations AS (
    SELECT 
        m.molecule_id,
        a1.element AS element1,
        a2.element AS element2
    FROM 
        connected c
    JOIN 
        atom a1 ON c.atom_id = a1.atom_id
    JOIN 
        atom a2 ON c.atom_id2 = a2.atom_id
    JOIN 
        molecule m ON a1.molecule_id = m.molecule_id
    WHERE 
        a1.element < a2.element
    GROUP BY 
        m.molecule_id, a1.element, a2.element
    QUALIFY 
        ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY m.molecule_id ORDER BY COUNT(*) DESC) = 1
),
MostCommonBondCount AS (
    SELECT 
        COUNT(b.bond_id) AS most_common_bond_count
    FROM 
        bond b
    JOIN 
        connected c ON b.bond_id = c.bond_id
    JOIN 
        atom a1 ON c.atom_id = a1.atom_id
    JOIN 
        atom a2 ON c.atom_id2 = a2.atom_id
    JOIN 
        MostCommonCombinations mcc ON a1.molecule_id = mcc.molecule_id
        AND ((a1.element = mcc.element1 AND a2.element = mcc.element2) OR (a1.element = mcc.element2 AND a2.element = mcc.element1))
),
TotalBondCount AS (
    SELECT 
        COUNT(bond_id) AS total_bond_count
    FROM 
        bond
)
SELECT 
    (most_common_bond_count * 100.0 / total_bond_count) AS percentage_of_most_common_bonds
FROM 
    MostCommonBondCount, TotalBondCount;

sql:
WITH MostCommonCombinations AS (
    SELECT 
        m.molecule_id,
        a1.element AS element1,
        a2.element AS element2
    FROM 
        connected c
    JOIN 
        atom a1 ON c.atom_id = a1.atom_id
    JOIN 
        atom a2 ON c.atom_id2 = a2.atom_id
    JOIN 
        molecule m ON a1.molecule_id = m.molecule_id
    WHERE 
        a1.element < a2.element
    GROUP BY 
        m.molecule_id, a1.element, a2.element
    QUALIFY 
        ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY m.molecule_id ORDER BY COUNT(*) DESC) = 1
),
CommonCombinationBondCount AS (
    SELECT 
        COUNT(DISTINCT b.bond_id) AS common_combination_bond_count
    FROM 
        bond b
    JOIN 
        connected c ON b.bond_id = c.bond_id
    JOIN 
        atom a1 ON c.atom_id = a1.atom_id
    JOIN 
        atom a2 ON c.atom_id2 = a2.atom_id
    JOIN 
        MostCommonCombinations mcc ON a1.molecule_id = mcc.molecule_id 
            AND a1.element = mcc.element1 
            AND a2.element = mcc.element2
),
TotalBondCount AS (
    SELECT 
        COUNT(*) AS total_bond_count
    FROM 
        bond
)
SELECT 
    (common_combination_bond_count * 100.0 / total_bond_count) AS percentage
FROM 
    CommonCombinationBondCount, TotalBondCount;

WITH MostCommonCombinations AS (
    SELECT 
        m.molecule_id,
        a1.element AS element1,
        a2.element AS element2
    FROM 
        connected c
    JOIN 
        atom a1 ON c.atom_id = a1.atom_id
    JOIN 
        atom a2 ON c.atom_id2 = a2.atom_id
    JOIN 
        molecule m ON a1.molecule_id = m.molecule_id
    WHERE 
        a1.element < a2.element
    GROUP BY 
        m.molecule_id, a1.element, a2.element
    QUALIFY 
        ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY m.molecule_id ORDER BY COUNT(*) DESC) = 1
),
CommonCombinationBondCount AS (
    SELECT 
        COUNT(DISTINCT b.bond_id) AS common_combination_bond_count
    FROM 
        bond b
    JOIN 
        connected c ON b.bond_id = c.bond_id
    JOIN 
        atom a1 ON c.atom_id = a1.atom_id
    JOIN 
        atom a2 ON c.atom_id2 = a2.atom_id
    JOIN 
        MostCommonCombinations mcc ON a1.molecule_id = mcc.molecule_id 
            AND a1.element = mcc.element1 
            AND a2.element = mcc.element2

WITH MostCommonCombinations AS (
    SELECT 
        m.molecule_id,
        a1.element AS element1,
        a2.element AS element2
    FROM 
        connected c
    JOIN 
        atom a1 ON c.atom_id = a1.atom_id
    JOIN 
        atom a2 ON c.atom_id2 = a2.atom_id
    JOIN 
        molecule m ON a1.molecule_id = m.molecule_id
    WHERE 
        a1.element < a2.element
    GROUP BY 
        m.molecule_id, a1.element, a2.element
    QUALIFY 
        ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY m.molecule_id ORDER BY COUNT(*) DESC) = 1
),
MostCommonBondCount AS (
    SELECT 
        COUNT(b.bond_id) AS most_common_bond_count
    FROM 
        bond b
    JOIN 
        connected c ON b.bond_id = c.bond_id
    JOIN 
        atom a1 ON c.atom_id = a1.atom_id
    JOIN 
        atom a2 ON c.atom_id2 = a2.atom_id
    JOIN 
        MostCommonCombinations mcc ON a1.molecule_id = mcc.molecule_id 
            AND a1.element = mcc.element1 
            AND a2.element = mcc.element2
),
TotalBondCount AS (
    SELECT 
        COUNT(bond_id) AS total_bond_count
    FROM 
        bond
)
SELECT 
    (most_common_bond_count * 100.0 / total_bond_count) AS percentage_of_most_common_bonds
FROM 
    MostCommonBondCount, TotalBondCount;

WITH loan_counts AS (
    SELECT 
        dist.A2 AS region,
        CASE 
            WHEN l.amount < 50000 THEN 'Small'
            ELSE 'Medium'
        END AS loan_size_category,
        l.status,
        COUNT(*) AS loan_count
    FROM 
        loan l
    JOIN 
        account a ON l.account_id = a.account_id
    JOIN 
        district dist ON a.district_id = dist.district_id
    WHERE 
        l.amount < 100000
    GROUP BY 
        dist.A2, loan_size_category, l.status
),
status_c_counts AS (
    SELECT 
        region,
        loan_size_category,
        loan_count AS c_count
    FROM 
        loan_counts
    WHERE 
        status = 'C'
),
total_counts AS (
    SELECT 
        region,
        loan_size_category,
        SUM(loan_count) AS total_count
    FROM 
        loan_counts
    GROUP BY 
        region, loan_size_category
),
percentage_c AS (
    SELECT 
        tc.region,
        tc.loan_size_category,
        COALESCE(sc.c_count, 0) AS c_count,
        tc.total_count,
        (COALESCE(sc.c_count, 0) * 100.0 / tc.total_count) AS percentage_c
    FROM 
        total_counts tc
    LEFT JOIN 
        status_c_counts sc ON tc.region = sc.region AND tc.loan_size_category = sc.loan_size_category
),
overall_average AS (
    SELECT 
        AVG(percentage_c) AS overall_average_percentage_c
    FROM 
        percentage_c
)
SELECT 
    pc.region,
    pc.loan_size_category,
    pc.percentage_c,
    oa.overall_average_percentage_c,
    (pc.percentage_c - oa.overall_average_percentage_c) AS difference_from_average
FROM 
    percentage_c pc,
    overall_average oa;

WITH carcinogenic_molecules AS (
  SELECT m.molecule_id
  FROM molecule m
  WHERE m.label = '+'
),
fluorine_molecules AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT m.molecule_id
  FROM molecule m
  JOIN atom a ON m.molecule_id = a.molecule_id
  WHERE m.label = '+'
  AND a.element = 'f'
),
atoms_per_molecule AS (
  SELECT m.molecule_id, COUNT(a.atom_id) AS atom_count
  FROM molecule m
  JOIN atom a ON m.molecule_id = a.molecule_id
  WHERE m.label = '+'
  GROUP BY m.molecule_id
),
bonds_per_molecule AS (
  SELECT m.molecule_id, COUNT(b.bond_id) AS bond_count
  FROM molecule m
  JOIN bond b ON m.molecule_id = b.molecule_id
  WHERE m.label = '+'
  GROUP BY m.molecule_id
),
bond_strength_per_molecule AS (
  SELECT b.molecule_id,
         AVG(CASE b.bond_type
              WHEN '-' THEN 1
              WHEN '=' THEN 2
              WHEN '#' THEN 3
              ELSE 0
            END) AS bond_strength
  FROM molecule m
  JOIN bond b ON m.molecule_id = b.molecule_id
  WHERE m.label = '+'
  GROUP BY b.molecule_id
)
SELECT
  (COUNT(DISTINCT cm.molecule_id) - COUNT(DISTINCT fm.molecule_id)) * 100.0 / COUNT(DISTINCT cm.molecule_id) AS percentage_without_fluorine,
  AVG(apm.atom_count) AS avg_atoms_per_molecule,
  AVG(CASE WHEN fm.molecule_id IS NOT NULL THEN bp.with_fluorine ELSE NULL END) AS avg_bonds_with_fluorine,
  AVG(CASE WHEN fm.molecule_id IS NULL THEN bp.without_fluorine ELSE NULL END) AS avg_bonds_without_fluorine,
  AVG(bs.bond_strength) AS avg_bond_strength
FROM carcinogenic_molecules cm
LEFT JOIN fluorine_molecules fm ON cm.molecule_id = fm.molecule_id
JOIN atoms_per_molecule apm ON cm.molecule_id = apm.molecule_id
JOIN (
  SELECT bp.molecule_id,
         CASE WHEN fm.molecule_id IS NOT NULL THEN bp.bond_count ELSE NULL END AS with_fluorine,
         CASE WHEN fm.molecule_id IS NULL THEN bp.bond_count ELSE NULL END AS without_fluorine
  FROM bonds_per_molecule bp
  LEFT JOIN fluorine_molecules fm ON bp.molecule_id = fm.molecule_id
) bp ON cm.molecule_id = bp.molecule_id
JOIN bond_strength_per_molecule bs ON cm.molecule_id = bs.molecule_id;

        CASE 
            WHEN l.amount < 50000 THEN 'Small'
            ELSE 'Medium'
        END AS loan_size_category,
        l.status,
        COUNT(*) AS loan_count
    FROM 
        loan l
    JOIN 
        account a ON l.account_id = a.account_id
    JOIN 
        district dist ON a.district_id = dist.district_id
    WHERE 
        l.amount < 100000
    GROUP BY 
        dist.A2, loan_size_category, l.status
),
status_c_counts AS (
    SELECT 
        region,
        loan_size_category,
        loan_count AS c_count
    FROM 
        loan_counts
    WHERE 
        status = 'C'
),
total_counts AS (
    SELECT 
        region,
        loan_size_category,
        SUM(loan_count) AS total_count
    FROM 
        loan_counts
    GROUP BY 
        region, loan_size_category
),
percentage_c AS (
    SELECT 
        tc.region,
        tc.loan_size_category,
        COALESCE(sc.c_count, 0) AS c_count,
        tc.total_count,
        (COALESCE(sc.c_count, 0) * 100.0 / tc.total_count) AS percentage_c
    FROM 
        total_counts tc
    LEFT JOIN 
        status_c_counts sc ON tc.region = sc.region AND tc.loan_size_category = sc.loan_size_category
),
overall_average AS (
    SELECT 
        AVG(percentage_c) AS overall_average_percentage_c
    FROM 
        percentage_c
)

FROM

SELECT 
    (COUNT(DISTINCT m.molecule_id) - COUNT(DISTINCT a.molecule_id)) * 100.0 / COUNT(DISTINCT m.molecule_id) AS percentage_without_fluorine,
    AVG(atom_count) AS avg_atoms_per_molecule,
    (SELECT AVG(bond_count) FROM (SELECT m.molecule_id, COUNT(b.bond_id) AS bond_count FROM molecule m JOIN bond b ON m.molecule_id = b.molecule_id WHERE m.label = '+' AND m.molecule_id = 'TR450' GROUP BY m.molecule_id)) AS avg_bonds_with_fluorine,
    (SELECT AVG(bond_count) FROM (SELECT m.molecule_id, COUNT(b.bond_id) AS bond_count FROM molecule m JOIN bond b ON m.molecule_id = b.molecule_id WHERE m.label = '+' AND m.molecule_id <> 'TR450' GROUP BY m.molecule_id)) AS avg_bonds_without_fluorine,
    AVG(bond_strength) AS avg_bond_strength
FROM 
    molecule m
LEFT JOIN 
    atom a ON m.molecule_id = a.molecule_id AND a.element = 'f'

    (SELECT m.molecule_id, COUNT(a.atom_id) AS atom_count FROM molecule m JOIN atom a ON m.molecule_id = a.molecule_id WHERE m.label = '+' GROUP BY m.molecule_id) atom_counts ON m.molecule_id = atom_counts.molecule_id

WITH loan_counts AS (
    SELECT 
        dist.A2 AS region,
        CASE 
            WHEN l.amount < 50000 THEN 'Small'
            ELSE 'Medium'
        END AS loan_size_category,
        l.status,
        COUNT(*) AS loan_count
    FROM 
        loan l
    JOIN 
        account a ON l.account_id = a.account_id
    JOIN 
        district dist ON a.district_id = dist.district_id
    WHERE 
        l.amount < 100000
    GROUP BY 
        dist.A2, loan_size_category, l.status
),
status_c_counts AS (
    SELECT 
        region,
        loan_size_category,
        loan_count AS c_count
    FROM 
        loan_counts
    WHERE 
        status = 'C'
),
total_counts AS (
    SELECT 
        region,
        loan_size_category,
        SUM(loan_count) AS total_count
    FROM 
        loan_counts
    GROUP BY 
        region, loan_size_category
),
percentage_c AS (
    SELECT 
        tc.region,
        tc.loan_size_category,
        COALESCE(sc.c_count, 0) AS c_count,
        tc.total_count,
        (COALESCE(sc.c_count, 0) * 100.0 / tc.total_count) AS percentage_c
    FROM 
        total_counts tc
    LEFT JOIN 
        status_c_counts sc ON tc.region = sc.region AND tc.loan_size_category = sc.loan_size_category
),
overall_average AS (
    SELECT 
        AVG(percentage_c) AS overall_average_percentage_c
    FROM 
        percentage_c
)

    pc.region,
    pc.loan_size_category,
    pc.percentage_c,
    oa.overall_average_percentage_c,
    CASE 
        WHEN pc.percentage_c > oa.overall_average_percentage_c THEN 'Above Average'
        ELSE 'Below Average'
    END AS performance_comparison
FROM 
    percentage_c pc,
    overall_average oa;

WITH carcinogenic_molecules AS (
  SELECT m.molecule_id
  FROM molecule m
  WHERE m.label = '+'
),
fluorine_molecules AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT m.molecule_id
  FROM molecule m
  JOIN atom a ON m.molecule_id = a.molecule_id
  WHERE m.label = '+'
  AND a.element = 'f'
),
atoms_per_molecule AS (
  SELECT m.molecule_id, COUNT(a.atom_id) AS atom_count
  FROM molecule m
  JOIN atom a ON m.molecule_id = a.molecule_id
  WHERE m.label = '+'
  GROUP BY m.molecule_id
),
bonds_per_molecule AS (
  SELECT m.molecule_id, COUNT(b.bond_id) AS bond_count
  FROM molecule m
  JOIN bond b ON m.molecule_id = b.molecule_id
  WHERE m.label = '+'
  GROUP BY m.molecule_id
),
bond_strength_per_molecule AS (
  SELECT b.molecule_id,
         AVG(CASE b.bond_type
              WHEN '-' THEN 1
              WHEN '=' THEN 2
              WHEN '#' THEN 3
              ELSE 0
            END) AS bond_strength
  FROM molecule m
  JOIN bond b ON m.molecule_id = b.molecule_id
  WHERE m.label = '+'
  GROUP BY b.molecule_id
)
SELECT
  (COUNT(DISTINCT cm.molecule_id) - COUNT(DISTINCT fm.molecule_id)) * 100.0 / COUNT(DISTINCT cm.molecule_id) AS percentage_without_fluorine,
  AVG(apm.atom_count) AS avg_atoms_per_molecule,
  AVG(CASE WHEN fm.molecule_id IS NOT NULL THEN bp.with_fluorine ELSE NULL END) AS avg_bonds_with_fluorine,
  AVG(CASE WHEN fm.molecule_id IS NULL THEN bp.without_fluorine ELSE NULL END) AS avg_bonds_without_fluorine,
  AVG(bs.bond_strength) AS avg_bond_strength
FROM carcinogenic_molecules cm
LEFT JOIN fluorine_molecules fm ON cm.molecule_id = fm.molecule_id
JOIN atoms_per_molecule apm ON cm.molecule_id = apm.molecule_id
JOIN (
  SELECT bp.molecule_id,
         CASE WHEN fm.molecule_id IS NOT NULL THEN bp.bond_count ELSE NULL END AS with_fluorine,
         CASE WHEN fm.molecule_id IS NULL THEN bp.bond_count ELSE NULL END AS without_fluorine
  FROM bonds_per_molecule bp
  LEFT JOIN fluorine_molecules fm ON bp.molecule_id = fm.molecule_id
) bp ON cm.molecule_id = bp.molecule_id
JOIN bond_strength_per_molecule bs ON cm.molecule_id = bs.molecule_id;

WITH loan_counts AS (
    SELECT 
        dist.A2 AS region,
        CASE 
            WHEN l.amount < 50000 THEN 'Small'
            ELSE 'Medium'
        END AS loan_size_category,
        l.status,
        COUNT(*) AS loan_count
    FROM 
        loan l
    JOIN 
        account a ON l.account_id = a.account_id
    JOIN 
        district dist ON a.district_id = dist.district_id
    WHERE 
        l.amount < 100000
    GROUP BY 
        dist.A2, loan_size_category, l.status
),
status_c_counts AS (
    SELECT 
        region,
        loan_size_category,
        loan_count AS c_count
    FROM 
        loan_counts
    WHERE 
        status = 'C'
),
total_counts AS (
    SELECT 
        region,
        loan_size_category,
        SUM(loan_count) AS total_count
    FROM 
        loan_counts
    GROUP BY 
        region, loan_size_category
),
percentage_c AS (
    SELECT 
        tc.region,
        tc.loan_size_category,
        COALESCE(sc.c_count, 0) AS c_count,
        tc.total_count,
        (COALESCE(sc.c_count, 0) * 100.0 / tc.total_count) AS percentage_c
    FROM 
        total_counts tc
    LEFT JOIN 
        status_c_counts sc ON tc.region = sc.region AND tc.loan_size_category = sc.loan_size_category
),
overall_average AS (
    SELECT 
        AVG(percentage_c) AS overall_average_percentage_c
    FROM 
        percentage_c
)
SELECT 
    pc.region,
    pc.loan_size_category,
    pc.percentage_c,
    oa.overall_average_percentage_c,
    (pc.percentage_c - oa.overall_average_percentage_c) AS difference_from_average
FROM 
    percentage_c pc,
    overall_average oa;

WITH loan_counts AS (
    SELECT 
        dist.A2 AS region,
        CASE 
            WHEN l.amount < 50000 THEN 'Small'
            ELSE 'Medium'
        END AS loan_size_category,
        l.status,
        COUNT(*) AS loan_count
    FROM 
        loan l
    JOIN 
        account a ON l.account_id = a.account_id
    JOIN 
        district dist ON a.district_id = dist.district_id
    WHERE 
        l.amount < 100000
    GROUP BY 
        dist.A2, loan_size_category, l.status
),
status_c_counts AS (
    SELECT 
        region,
        loan_size_category,
        loan_count AS c_count

        loan_counts
    WHERE 
        status = 'C'
),
total_counts AS (
    SELECT 
        region,
        loan_size_category,
        SUM(loan_count) AS total_count

        loan_counts

    SELECT 
        tc.region,

        COALESCE(sc.c_count, 0) AS c_count,

        (COALESCE(sc.c_count, 0) * 100.0 / tc.total_count) AS c_percentage

        total_counts tc
    LEFT JOIN 
        status_c_counts sc ON tc.region = sc.region AND tc.loan_size_category = sc.loan_size_category
),
overall_average AS (

    WHERE c.type = 'gold'
    GROUP BY di.A3
),
overall_counts AS (
    SELECT 
        SUM(gold_cards_before_1998) AS total_gold_before_1998,
        SUM(total_gold_cards) AS total_gold_cards
    FROM gold_cards_before_1998
    JOIN total_gold_cards USING (A3)
)
